name: rocket-plus-mcp
description: AI-powered CRM automation with 56+ tools for contacts, leads, content generation, courses, workflows, and marketing. Natural language control over your CRM - create contacts, generate courses, automate follow-ups, and more.

environment_variables.name: ROCKET_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Your Rocket+ API key from https://rocketadd.com/settings

tools.name: get_contacts
tools.description: Search and retrieve contacts from the CRM. Filter by query, tags, or limit results.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create a new contact with name, email, phone, tags, and custom fields.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Send an SMS message to a contact.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email to a contact with subject and HTML body.

tools.name: course_generate
tools.description: Generate a complete course with modules, lessons, and quizzes using AI.

tools.name: content_generate
tools.description: Generate marketing content - blog posts, emails, social posts, landing pages.

tools.name: create_opportunity
tools.description: Create a new deal in a pipeline with value and contact association.

tools.name: rocketflow_deploy
tools.description: Deploy workflow automations, pipelines, custom fields, and tags to the CRM.

tools.name: agent_execute
tools.description: Run AI agents for lead qualification, proposals, and automated follow-ups.

tools.name: skillforge_execute
tools.description: Execute AI skills like lead scoring, proposal generation, and content loops.

tools.name: insights_analyze
tools.description: Get AI-powered insights and analytics from your CRM data.

tools.name: seo_analyze
tools.description: Analyze pages for SEO issues and get optimization suggestions.

prompts.name: get_my_leads
prompts.description: Get recent leads from the CRM

prompts.name: create_course
prompts.description: Generate a new course on any topic

prompts.name: follow_up
prompts.description: Send a follow-up message to a contact
prompts.template: Send a follow-up SMS to {{contact_name}} saying {{message}}

prompts.name: generate_content
prompts.template: Write a {{type:blog post}} about {{topic}} in a {{tone:professional}} tone

prompts.name: analyze_performance
prompts.description: Get insights on your CRM performance
prompts.template: Analyze my {{metric:contacts}} performance for the last {{timeframe:30 days}}

resources.name: CRM Location Info
resources.description: Current CRM location and account details

resources.name: Available Mods
resources.description: List of Rocket+ mods enabled for your account
